synopsis: Chapter 13 and the glossary agree that Directive (EU) 2024/2853 applies to products placed on the market after 9 December 2026; one Chapter 13 statement also includes products put into service after that date [f10676, f11178, f12422]. Both locations explicitly classify software, including updates, as a product [f10678, f12423]. Courts may order evidence disclosure, and defectiveness may be presumed if disclosure is not provided or technical complexity makes proof excessively difficult; Chapter 13 identifies these provisions in the text published on 18 November 2024 [f10679, f10680, f12424]. Dreyfus commentary dated 25 September 2026 reportedly says a 7 May 2026 corrigendum confirmed the applicability wording, but the supplied fact does not reproduce that wording [f10677].
